# Case 25: Directional claim and quoted copy left stale after a rerun
Skill: write-revision-responses
Expected gates: G-RV-rerun, G-RV-sync
Language: en
Snippet:
> After the energy model changed, all experiments were rerun and the tables were regenerated. The abstract still reports an improvement of 4%–210%, the letter still quotes the old table, and the text still says that the proposed method uses less total energy on all three instances, although it now uses more on two of them.
Why it fails: prose numbers, quoted copies, and directional claims were not updated with the tables after the rerun.
